text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's time for Tracen Academy's<n>yearly summer
camp. Symboli Rudolf<n>stays behind until the last
minute<n>conducting final checks.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Despite the time crunch, she's totally<n>unhurried,
and she makes it in perfect<n>time for the summer
camp's official<n>opening with a little help from
Maruzensky.
